title: OpenAI officially releases GPT-6 Astra with new features and pricing
summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, its flagship model described as the most intelligent and consistent in the world. Improvements include better context retention in Codex, bug detection, refactoring, autonomous software testing, and vulnerability discovery including zero-day exploits. A new feature 'Sites' allows creating, hosting, and publishing websites, web apps, and games from a prompt. On the ARC-AGI 3 benchmark, the new GPT scored 99.9%, a significant breakthrough as only humans previously achieved 100%. Pricing is set at $10 per 1M input tokens and $50 per 1M output tokens, with a Fast mode available at double the price. The model is being rolled out to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise users and via API and AWS Bedrock.
